notes.title: HotFix v0.11 # Music Producer Tycoon
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/JZ8HqFfXVs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614399/9ff70ac3b8c34ccb6e4c4950fdef8f654c094fb3.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hi everyone![/b][/h1]

We’re back with a new hotfix for the Music Producer Tycoon demo.

Thanks to your continued feedback, we’ve made several key improvements to polish the experience even further.

Here’s what’s been fixed and updated in this hotfix:

[h1][b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Scoring system now works as intended.

[*] Info pop-up animations have been changed to a smoother FadeIn effect.

[*] Our character now actually uses a mic when performing.

[*] Right-click now also works to open the Action Menu (e.g. Create a Song).

[*] Space Bar can now be used to skip the tutorial.

[*] You can now decline concerts if you're not ready to perform.

[*] A new theme unlock system has been implemented.

[*] Theme and genre unlock prices now display the correct values.

[*] Money display now correctly shows your real in-game funds.

[h1][b]Add to Wishlist Now![/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Play the Demo Now![/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3680000/Music_Producer_Tycoon_Demo/

Thank you again for your support,

[b]The Music Producer Tycoon Team[/b]

notes.title: HotFix v0.9 # Music Producer Tycoon
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/JZ8HqFfXVs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614399/9ff70ac3b8c34ccb6e4c4950fdef8f654c094fb3.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hi everyone![/b][/h1]

Thank you so much for playing the Music Producer Tycoon demo during Steam Next Fest! Your amazing support, thoughtful feedback, and passion for music have truly inspired us.

We’ve heard your comments loud and clear. Our team has been working non-stop to smooth out the rough edges and elevate the experience. Here’s what we’ve improved so far:

[h1][b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Moved the Information feature from individual info buttons to an integrated system for improved accessibility.

[*] Fixed a bug where double background music would play during concert events.

[*] Resolved visual glitches caused by conflicts between the tutorial and other UI elements.

[*] Fixed an issue where opening and closing the music creation menu after concerts caused a concert-related bug.

[*] Fixed the floating Research Notes bug.

[*] Corrected missing texts in the total summary section.

[*] Added the "Audience" title between Music Name and Vinyls for clarity.

[*] Added a currency symbol to relevant texts to indicate required money amounts.

[*] Tickets now accurately display the player's remaining demo song generation limit.

[*] Fixed incorrect UI highlights.

[*] Default language is now set to English.

[*] Revised the size of UI highlights for better visibility and consistency.

[/list]

This is just the beginning we're fully committed to making Music Producer Tycoon the best music industry simulation out there. Your feedback is instrumental to shaping this game, so keep it coming!
